name: @repo/ee-license
description: Offline enterprise-license verification + self-host entitlement rules. Open code by design: it must run on unlicensed self-hosted instances to deny EE features. Verifies Ed25519-signed license tokens locally — no network call, ever (the self-host distribution promises zero phone-home). The gated feature implementations live under ee/ directories; this package only answers 'is this deployment self-hosted, is it licensed, and is this entitlement key EE-gated?'.
